question: Classify files025-028 direct outward dependencies by actual provider and caller use.
procedure: Read all three nt_graph direct headers and reached providers; compare nt_inthk original include and retained body; trace mapping initialization/release and mouse/page-domain cursor publication.

25.finding: C0044/C0053/C0055：文本刷新/配置和路由查询使用当前session发布者；图形begin/end维护覆盖层、update_depth和dirty通知。不是平台独立能力，归S13原版绘图与产品发布接线。

26.finding: C0031：固定原版第34行已有gdpvar.h include；当前保留的回调实现没有直接GDP访问。不能把无使用误记成需要GDP；删除原版include会新增镜像差异，本批不实施。归S14生成载体统一归属及必要性审查。

27.finding: C0041：InitIntelMemory成功发布前初始化F映射记录并注册session teardown；FreeIntelMemory先释放记录再释放Intel内存。归S13映射生命周期，与013/023成组，不迁声明掩盖调用。

28.finding: C0045/C0050：route_active和mouse_apply使用当前session鼠标队列；publish_cursor校验domain.active、owner、PG、CR3后写入既有WOW视图。归S13输入路由与页域生命周期，保留原版ICA锁和调用顺序。

validation: Source classification only. No source/build/runtime/release change. P20 package remains current; this is not behavioral proof or dependency elimination.

followUp.S13: Group display publication, mapping lifetime and mouse/page-domain callers with prior reviewed consumers.
followUp.S14: Resolve generated ABI carrier ownership; nt_inthk is an original but apparently unused direct include, not a demonstrated GDP consumer.
